text:
alex.k: Quick ping — PR #8290 updates the REST client headers shim + adds a streaming->non-streaming fallback for toolcall timeouts. Need 1-2 reviewers before EOD, targeting merge tomorrow AM. TL;DR: reorder header precedence (route > user > default), fallback when stream stalls, default toolcall timeout bumped to 12s.

sam: can you paste the shim snippet? worried about breaking older SDKs that depend on header overwrite order.

alex.k: snippet below — really small change:
```js
// clients/rest/headers_shim.ts
export function mergeHeaders(routeHeaders, userHeaders, defaults) {
  return { ...defaults, ...userHeaders, ...routeHeaders };
}
```
alex.k: also added unit test toolcall_stream_timeout.test.ts that simulates partial chunks then EOF -> fallback decode.

mira: route winning makes sense. question: does this match the smart router logic? if proxies rewrite auth headers we might get surprises — we should add a light ingress integration test for dedicated.

jen: CI note — streaming-slow-chunks is flaky on macOS runners, it failed on this branch. @ci-bot can you rerun just that job?

ci-bot: circlci/checkout ✅, build/test 3/4 — streaming-slow-chunks failed on macos-12. Rerun queued by jen.

sam: minor nit — prefer explicit deepClone to avoid prototype pollution: `const merged = deepClone(defaults); Object.assign(merged, userHeaders, routeHeaders)`; also add a code comment about backcompat assumption.

alex.k: good call. I'll swap to deepClone and add comments. planning to add a canary rollout flag in deploy config so we can monitor toolcall error-rate for 24h post-merge.

mira: I'll give eyes after the deepClone change + ingress integration test. if e2e looks good i'll +1.

jen: I'll watch CI and approve once streaming-slow-chunks stabilizes. :thumbsup:

alex.k: thanks — tagging @sam @mira. plan: merge after 1x +1 and green CI, unless a blocker shows up.
